text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During my trip into town, I see Meisho Doto apologetically lowering her head to the bronze statue in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry about that! Do you have any injuries? Are your clothes stained?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer! So, um, I was walking, and… my legs started feeling numb, and then I tripped, and I bumped into this person!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The collision was pretty strong. Look how sickly their face is… Um, huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: This is a br-bronze statue? I'm apologizing to a bronze statue? But why?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto seems to be dealing with a lot of fatigue… I may want to rethink her race schedule.
